description: This file defines an interface 'ITimerRegistry' for managing grain timers within the Orleans framework. It declares methods to create and register timers associated with grains, with different options and deprecations.

classes.name: ITimerRegistry
classes.description: An interface for managing grain timers, providing methods to register timers with various configurations.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Creates a grain timer that invokes a callback after a delay and possibly periodically. This method is marked obsolete.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Registers a grain timer with specific options, supporting strongly typed callback functions.
